# The auth CLI discovers a relative auth_file, initializes it privately, and never prints stored secrets.
mkdir config
cp config.toml config/config.toml
stdin first-password.txt
exec mina --config-file config/config.toml auth init Admin@Local
stdout 'Initialized .*config/auth.toml with user admin@local'
stdout 'Authentication changes take effect after Mina restarts.'
stderr '^Password: Confirm password: $'
exists config/auth.toml
exec find config/auth.toml -perm 0600 -print
stdout 'config/auth.toml'
grep '^version = 1$' config/auth.toml
grep '^signing_secret = ' config/auth.toml
grep 'password_hash = .*.argon2id' config/auth.toml
! grep 'first-password' config/auth.toml

# A representative user mutation normalizes email and announces restart semantics.
stdin second-password.txt
exec mina --config-file config/config.toml auth user add SECOND@LOCAL
stdout 'Added user second@local'
stdout 'Authentication changes take effect after Mina restarts.'

# API key plaintext is revealed once; subsequent listing exposes metadata only.
exec mina --config-file config/config.toml auth api-key create automation
stdout 'Created API key automation'
stdout 'API key \(shown once\): mina_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+'
stdout 'Authentication changes take effect after Mina restarts.'
exec mina --config-file config/config.toml auth api-key list
stdout 'automation.*prefix='
! stdout 'mina_'
! stdout 'token_digest'
! stdout 'revoked'

# Revocation deletes the active record from listing and TOML and frees its label for immediate reuse.
exec mina --config-file revoke-config.toml auth api-key revoke EQO-K-an
stdout 'Revoked API key integration'
exec mina --config-file revoke-config.toml auth api-key list
! stdout 'integration'
stdout 'unrelated.*prefix='
! grep 'label = "integration"' revoke-auth.toml
! grep 'revoked' revoke-auth.toml
exec mina --config-file revoke-config.toml auth api-key create integration
stdout 'Created API key integration'
exec mina --config-file revoke-config.toml auth api-key list
stdout 'integration.*prefix='
stdout 'unrelated.*prefix='

# CLI-only mutations retain the startup snapshot until a launched server restarts.
freeport
exec mina --config-file config/config.toml serve --db $WORK/auth.db --yes --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT --quiet &original_server&
httpwait -timeout 15s '"status":"ok"' http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/health
httpget -save-cookie-env OLD_SESSION -method POST -body first-login.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/auth/login
stdout '"authenticated":true'

stdin replacement-password.txt
exec mina --config-file config/config.toml auth user set-password admin@local
stdout 'Changed password for admin@local'
httpget -method POST -body first-login.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/auth/login
stdout '"authenticated":true'
httpget -method POST -status 401 -body replacement-login.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/auth/login
httpget -cookie-env OLD_SESSION http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/settings
stdout '"groups"'
kill -INT original_server
wait original_server

freeport
exec mina --config-file config/config.toml serve --db $WORK/auth.db --yes --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT --quiet &password_server&
httpwait -timeout 15s '"status":"ok"' http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/health
httpget -method POST -status 401 -body first-login.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/auth/login
httpget -save-cookie-env REPLACEMENT_SESSION -method POST -body replacement-login.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/auth/login
stdout '"authenticated":true'
httpget -cookie-env OLD_SESSION -status 401 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/settings

exec mina --config-file config/config.toml auth user disable admin@local
stdout 'Set user admin@local enabled=false'
httpget -method POST -body replacement-login.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/auth/login
stdout '"authenticated":true'
httpget -cookie-env REPLACEMENT_SESSION http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/settings
stdout '"groups"'
kill -INT password_server
wait password_server

freeport
exec mina --config-file config/config.toml serve --db $WORK/auth.db --yes --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT --quiet &disabled_server&
httpwait -timeout 15s '"status":"ok"' http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/health
httpget -method POST -status 401 -body replacement-login.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/auth/login
httpget -cookie-env REPLACEMENT_SESSION -status 401 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/settings
kill -INT disabled_server
wait disabled_server

-- config.toml --
